CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Available shipping options are shown during checkout for the active shipment
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open checkout shipping step with a valid cart that has shippable items. Confirm options list is displayed for each shipment context.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Shipping options are visible for the shipment context.
No blocking empty-state error is shown for valid carts.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer can choose a shipping option and persist selection
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select one method, continue, then return to shipping step and verify selected method remains.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Selection is accepted and persisted.
Order summary reflects the selected method.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Default shipping option is applied when customer does not manually change it
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Proceed through shipping without changing the preselected method and review checkout summary and backend-visible result.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
A default method is applied and checkout can proceed.
Default behavior is consistent with epic AC intent.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Split-shipment behavior follows expected local and remote shipment option constraints
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use a split cart scenario and verify local shipment has selectable methods while remote shipment behavior follows expected rule set.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Local shipment offers selectable methods.
Remote shipment rule application is consistent with configured behavior.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Porter empty-cart flow does not fail before first item is added
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Create or use an empty cart, set address, then add first item and continue shipping flow.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No blocker occurs while cart has no shipment yet.
Shipment-related flow initializes correctly after first item is added.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Invalid shipment or method inputs surface safe, user-facing errors
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Exercise invalid shipmentId/method/cart combinations via UI path and verify visible feedback while checkout stays stable.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Errors are handled without breaking checkout.
Messages are consistent and do not expose internal details.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Shipping option access respects cart ownership and user context
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run guest and logged-in paths and validate that cart access from another user context is not exploitable.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Authorized user/guest flows work.
Cross-user access does not expose or mutate protected cart data.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Porter and mytheresa-compatible behaviors coexist without regression
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Execute core shipping-option checks on both target storefronts and compare expected behavior deltas.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Brand-specific behavior is respected.
No regression blocks the existing mytheresa-like flow.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Chosen shipping option is reflected in checkout summary consistently
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select methods in each scenario and inspect checkout summary presentation before final confirmation step.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Summary reflects selected option per shipment context.
Displayed value remains consistent after navigation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Core shipping options behavior is consistent on desktop and mobile checkout
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat critical checks on desktop and mobile viewport for NAP and MRP acceptance storefronts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Core flow is usable on both form factors.
No visible performance blocker in loading options list.
